playerTransportDiagnostics.issueIdentified: Premature isPlaying state transition at T=0ms before audio buffered
playerTransportDiagnostics.rootCause: soundController onPlay hook synchronously fired on HTMLAudioElement play() and set isPlaying=true, showing Pause icon (❚❚) at 0:00 while network stream was still buffering (2.5-3.5s latency).
playerTransportDiagnostics.resolution: Decoupled isPlaying from onPlay. isPlaying is now set strictly on onPlaying (when media begins audible playback). isLoading is displayed via dock-spinner during buffering window.
playerTransportDiagnostics.verification: Puppeteer browser test confirmed clean buffer progression from readyState 0 (buffering) to readyState 4 (playing) and advancing past 6.8s without false pause state.
